rationale: One immutable content-addressed body service should back many semantic heads.
Head/frontier tracking should reuse existing temporal/continuity laws instead of creating a second time plane.
Change events should become the existing delta/occurrence envelope, not a parallel event log.
Object×capability Cartesian products should be derivable from laws plus local exceptions.
Execution interpretations are high-value but should usually be lazy bindings, not durable per-object state.
Arrow Flight can remain a transport phenotype while routing/address ownership stays native.
OpenDAL is a useful carrier adapter; it should not become a new addressing authority.
Graph views should lower from typed semantic relations instead of ID-column heuristics.
Iceberg adds a real historical table algebra while reusing immutable bodies.
Distinct vector/tensor/multimodal layouts are legitimate physical representations.
They can be substrates behind native scheduling/delta ownership rather than a new orchestration plane.
Derived material must retain derived standing and existing proof/promotion semantics.
Temperature/eviction belongs in mature resource/economic policy rather than format-local policy.
